errors.evidence: The vertical axis is not labeled. 'Recall@10' is the title of the chart.
The bar for "Ours" appears to be exactly at 0.35, the midpoint between 0.3 and 0.4. The value 0.36 is a slight overestimation.
The bar for "- critiquing" is visibly below the 0.3 gridline. Its value is closer to 0.29. Stating it is 0.31 is factually incorrect.
The bar for "- ranking" is clearly below the midpoint between 0.2 and 0.3 (which would be 0.25). Its value is closer to 0.23.
The bar for "- scoring" appears to be closer to 0.17. The value 0.18 is a slight overestimation.

errors.text_span: The chart illustrates that removing the critiquing component has the smallest impact on performance, while removing the scoring component has the largest impact.
errors.evidence: This sentence interprets the results of the ablation study ('impact on performance') rather than describing the visual elements of the chart. The chart shows absolute performance values, not the change or 'impact' from removing a component.
